# tsuru_role (Resource)

Manages a tsuru role and its complete set of permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tsuru_role" "deployer" {
  name        = "deployer"
  context     = "app"
  description = "Application deployment role"

  permissions = [
    "app",
    "app.deploy",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `context` (String) Context type associated with the role. Valid values are: global, app, job, team, user, pool, service, service-instance, volume, and router
- `name` (String) Unique role name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description associated with the role
- `permissions` (Set of String) Complete set of permissions associated with the role

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
